business.title: Open a job position
business.goal: Make an approved hiring need available for applications under its responsible hiring manager.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Open a job position with its title, department, description, headcount, and responsible hiring manager.

outcome.statement: The job position is open and can receive applications.
evidence: An open job position shows its title, department, headcount, and responsible hiring manager.

business.title: Register a candidate
business.goal: Create or attach the candidate's master record so it can be used in hiring applications.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Look up the person by available identifying contact information before registration.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Create or attach the candidate record, record the recruitment source, and associate the candidate's resume through the platform-managed attachment service.

outcome.statement: The candidate is available as a single master record for hiring activities.
evidence: A candidate record displays the person's name and email.
The candidate has a recruitment source and an associated resume attachment.

business.title: Start screening an application
business.goal: Associate a candidate with an open job position and begin screening.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the candidate who is applying.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the candidate information and available resume.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the open job position for the application.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the job position and its remaining hiring need.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Record the candidate's application for the selected job position and start it in screening.

outcome.statement: The candidate has an application in the screening stage for the selected position.
evidence: An application links the candidate to the job position.

business.title: Advance an application to interview
business.goal: Move a screened candidate forward to the interview stage.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the application in screening.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the candidate, position, and screening information.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the candidate's qualifications and available resume before advancing the application.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Move the application from screening to interview.

outcome.statement: The application is ready for interview review.

business.title: Decide whether to make an offer
business.goal: Make the hiring decision for an interviewed candidate assigned to the manager's position.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the interviewed application for a position managed by the hiring manager.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the interviewed candidate and the job position.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the candidate's qualifications and available resume before making the offer decision.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Choose whether to make an offer or decline the candidate.

steps.title: x
steps.description: When an offer is selected, move the application from interview to offer.

steps.title: x
steps.description: When the candidate is declined, refer the application to the recruiter to record the rejection reason.

outcome.statement: An interviewed candidate is either advanced to offer or referred for rejection processing.
evidence: For an offer decision, the application stage is offer.
For a decline decision, the recruiter receives the application for rejection processing.

business.title: Decide the hiring outcome
business.goal: Decide whether a candidate with an offer is hired.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the application in the offer stage for a position managed by the hiring manager.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the offered candidate and job position before the final hiring decision.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the position's remaining hiring need before confirming a hire.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Choose whether to hire the candidate or decline the application.

steps.title: x
steps.description: When hiring is selected, move the application from offer to hired; filling the position's headcount closes the position automatically.

steps.title: x
steps.description: When hiring is declined, refer the application to the recruiter to record the rejection reason.

outcome.statement: The offered candidate is either hired or referred for rejection processing.
evidence: For a hire decision, the application stage is hired.
When the final hire fills the position headcount, the job position is closed automatically.
For a decline decision, the recruiter receives the application for rejection processing.

business.title: Record an application rejection
business.goal: Close a declined application with its rejection reason.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Locate the application that will not proceed.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the application and its current stage before recording the outcome.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Review the position context before recording the rejection.

steps.title: x
steps.description: Move the application to rejected and record the rejection reason.

outcome.statement: The application is rejected with an explained outcome.
evidence: The application displays a rejection reason.
